appraisal_events.evidence: « Mais vous devez être plus avancé que moi dans ses confidences, vous qui êtes le grand favori, le grand crack comme disent les Anglais. »
appraisal_events.explanation: Odette directly characterizes the narrator as Gilberte's greatest favorite among her friends, marking him as a privileged insider in the child's confidence and affection.

status_effects.explanation: Odette's remark positions the narrator as a favored insider in Gilberte's circle of friends, a mild elevation of his social standing within the Swann household.

ambiguities: The passage describing the narrator as the former 'étranger, ce paria' now offered a delightful chair by Gilberte is embedded in an essayistic meditation on memory and enchantment rather than a discretely staged social interaction; it echoes the same inclusion movement as S1 but was not scored as a separate event given its reflective register.

Odette's compliment carries a faint self-regarding note (her showcasing of English slang), which may slightly qualify the sincerity of the praise, though the substance of the compliment toward the narrator stands.
